notes:
V3.1.7 — version-bug FIFTH try (with diagnostic log) + UI polish batch.

VERSION FIX (this one is genuinely bulletproof)
• The version is now baked into THREE places at build time: apex_version.py at the project root (top-level absolute import), core/_version.py (relative back-compat), AND installer.iss (so the Inno wizard finally shows the real version too — the previous installer always said v1.0.0).
• core/updater.py tries each in order. PyInstaller's relative-import quirks can no longer cause both embeds to fail at once.
• Writes a one-line diagnostic to DATA_DIR/apex_version_diag.log on first call — every launch records which resolution path won (e.g. 'resolved=3.1.7  source=apex_version.py (top-level)'). If a future build ever reports the wrong version, paste that log and the cause is immediately visible.
• tools/embed_version.py now patches installer.iss MyAppVersion too.

UI POLISH
• 🖼  Window icon — the title bar finally shows the APEX icon instead of the default exe glyph. Same icon for LoginWindow + every dialog.
• 🎨  Theme picker — Account tab → APPEARANCE. Five palettes (Default dark-teal / Midnight Blue / Forest / Cyberpunk / Solarized Dark) with a colour-swatch preview. Saves to apex_settings.json; applies on next restart (the global stylesheet is baked at launch).
• ⭐  Admin classify UI — new section in ADMIN tab: type a bot slug, click 'Toggle FEATURED' or 'Toggle RECOMMENDED'. No more curl. BOSS/SUB-BOSS/ADMIN can use it; the server still enforces the role check.
